description: This file defines an Angular component 'DestinationPageComponent' that displays details of a destination and provides functionality to add it to an itinerary. It imports various Angular modules, UI components, and application-specific models and stores. The component uses dependency injection, signals, computed properties, and handles user interactions.

classes.name: DestinationPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying destination details and adding destination to an itinerary.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, extracting destination data from route snapshot into a signal.

methods.name: destination
methods.description: Computed property returning current destination data.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: addToItinerary
methods.description: Async method to create a new itinerary linked to the current user, with a stub implementation for adding destination.

ctags.name: data
ctags.pattern: /^    const data = this.route.snapshot.data?.['destination'] as Destination | null | undefined;$/
